summary: Frontend-only testing focused on the 'placeholder flash' bug fix (CNPJ: -- / Nome: Carregando...). Used fast polling (~80-100ms) over several seconds right after navigation and refresh to catch any momentary flash. All 5 targeted scenarios PASS: (1) login with 33648223000119 -> first visible state is already '33.648.223/0001-19' + 'SILVANI GONCALVES MACHADO 26267405869' at t=2220ms (login spinner respected >=2s minimum); (2) full page reload with active session -> first sample at t=3ms already shows correct CNPJ/Nome, no flash; (3) navigation to pgmei3 (Emitir DAS) -> first sample at t=3ms already correct; (4) logout clears sessionStorage (pgmei_cnpj=null, pgmei_nome=null) and login with 37411286000108 shows 'LUCI SCHIAVI DA SILVA 42017335215' with ZERO leak of the previous SILVANI name in any sample; (5) regression invalid CNPJ 11111111111111 keeps user on pgmei.html with red error banner 'CNPJ inválido. Verifique os dígitos informados.'. The inline sessionStorage-prefill script on pgmei2.html / pgmei3.html and the Promise.all([consulta, minimo2s]) gating on pgmei.html are working as designed.
critical_code_review_comments: Fix is solid: pre-fetching name on login page in parallel with the 2s spinner avoids showing the inner page until data is ready; sessionStorage cache + inline fill-on-first-paint eliminates refresh/navigation flash; encerrarSessao() correctly removes pgmei_cnpj, pgmei_nome and pgmei_cnpj_fmt.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Flash bug fix fully verified via rapid polling (80-100ms) of #pg-cnpj and #pg-nome. If regression testing is needed in future, reuse the sampling approach: open iframe[data-testid=pgmei-frame], then poll textContent of #pg-cnpj and #pg-nome right after click/navigate/reload - any sample containing '--' or 'Carregando...' indicates a regression.
